scientific_integrity: Analytic factorial-moment proof with exhaustive independent small-size enumerations. No independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: No total-variation rate; conditional fixed-point counts only; possible implicit coverage by broader random-mapping or rook-theoretic limit results. Finite factorial identities are not claimed independently novel.
title: Poisson–Bernoulli limits for fixed points of random mappings conditioned on their fibres
